text:
ana_docs: FYI I opened a small PR to tighten up parsing policy examples and add fixed SDK snippets for function/tool calling. it's blocking a couple of doclinks from the migration guide. PTAL @mike_eng @sophia
mike_eng: on it
sophia: can you paste the problematic snippet?
ana_docs: link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452 — main problems I noticed:
  1) python example prints raw response dict which confuses users about envelope vs direct JSON
  2) js streaming snippet is missing `await` on the stream iterator so it errors in runtime
  3) schema sample accidentally sets `additionalProperties: true` which undermines the guardrail example
riley: I can take the py bits, adding a short helper to unwrap envelope safely. also will add a one-liner eval showing parse fallback behavior :+1:
docs-bot: CI note: docs-linter failed on links in PR 452, see `https://ci.redwood.local/docs/452/logs`
ana_docs: thanks riley — could you add both variants for tool fields (explicit `null` and omitted) to show parser behavior on optional tool outputs? that was a frequent support question
mike_eng: i'll push a tiny js fix — streaming helper + small test. also will update the SDK snippet to use `await stream.next()` in the example
sophia: for guardrails, do we want to show an example where a tool returns a union type (string|object) and how to normalize? that's tripping people up
a na_docs: yes show both the schema and a small shim: `if isinstance(res, str): res = json.loads(res)` (py) and a short note in js about `typeof` check
riley: pushed `docs/452-py-unpack` with helper and a short test case. also replaced the `print(response.json())` with `print(parsed.output)`
mike_eng: pushed `docs/452-js-await` with the streaming await and a minor readme tweak
ana_docs: i updated the PR description to call out the migration guide link that needs updating in `docs/migration/sdk.md` — one link still pointed to the old envelope section
sophia: small suggestion: change wording from "optional" to "nullable" in the schema example so folks don't conflate omission vs null
riley: updated schema example to use "nullable": true and added a comment explaining the difference
docs-bot: linkcheck passed after the fixes; lint passed too
mike_eng: one follow-up idea: add a short subsection in the SDK migration guide titled "Parse fallbacks and tool outputs" with 3 bullets (envelope, direct json, null/absent tool) — I'll draft it after this merges
a na_docs: please also add an explicit snippet showing how `parse_with_schema()` handles arrays vs single-object returns — that was the other common regression
riley: added an array example and a tiny note about `one_of` union handling
sophia: LGTM from product POV — the examples look clearer now
a na_docs: CI green, requesting reviews from @eng and @devex, merging once reviews complete
docs-bot: PR #452 updated: reviewers requested: eng, devex
mike_eng: reviewers approved, pushed small test tweak
ana_docs: merging in 5 — thanks everyone :tada:
docs-bot: PR #452 merged by ana_docs
ana_docs: filing follow-up issue for the SDK migration subsection (will reference #452)
